description: Needs PROTON_DRIVE_INDEX=1. Refreshes the saved folder index of a huge drive in slices: re-lists folders last listed over maxAgeHours ago or never, oldest first, until timeBudgetMs, and saves progress. Repeat until complete:true (etaCalls). Younger folders are skipped. changes:true adds counts and up to 50 sample paths. Changes nothing on Drive.

maxAgeHours.description: Re-list folders listed longer ago than this (default 24).

name: drive_refresh_index
title: Refresh folder index
